# Simple Icons subset

35 unchanged SVG files from [Simple Icons 16.0.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/28241d80f8422eaed317ef968ad1e40b6d0d9163), commit `28241d80f8422eaed317ef968ad1e40b6d0d9163`. Their filenames receive a `brand-` prefix; bytes are unchanged. Original files are in `src/ServerDesk.App/Assets/Brands/` in the source repository and `icons/` beside this notice in application packages.

`manifest.json` records SHA-256 hashes and the upstream title, source, guidelines and individual license metadata for each icon. `LICENSE.md` (CC0 dedication) and `DISCLAIMER.md` are original upstream files. The collection's CC0 dedication does not replace individual artwork licenses or grant trademark rights.

- Debian open-use swirl: copyright © 1999 Software in the Public Interest, Inc.; created by Raul Silva. Source and attribution: https://www.debian.org/logos/ . Used under CC-BY-SA-3.0.
- Jenkins artwork: Jenkins project contributors; source https://get.jenkins.io/art/ and https://www.jenkins.io/press/ . Used under CC-BY-SA-3.0, as recorded by upstream.
- Rocky Linux artwork: Rocky Linux branding contributors; original source commit is linked in the manifest. Used under CC-BY-SA-4.0.
- Apache feather: Apache Software Foundation; original source/guidelines are linked in the manifest. Used under Apache-2.0.
- Other artwork: credited projects and Simple Icons contributors; see the individual source/guideline entries. Linux/Tux originates with Larry Ewing; the Linux trademark belongs to Linus Torvalds. Brand names and marks remain their owners' property.

Applicable Apache-2.0, CC-BY-SA-3.0 and CC-BY-SA-4.0 license texts accompany this notice. The original SVGs remain available separately under their respective licenses. In the interface, filled silhouettes use the current foreground color and scale to the icon slot; they identify user-selected systems/services without suggesting endorsement. ServerDesk's own Windows Server symbol is a generic four-pane drawing under the project's MIT license and is not an upstream Microsoft logo.
